conducting_body: National Testing Agency (NTA)
purpose: Admission to NITs, IIITs, GFTIs and centrally funded technical institutes; also the qualifying stage for JEE Advanced (IIT admission)
eligibility_summary: Class 12 (10+2) pass with Physics, Mathematics and Chemistry/Biology; qualifying year 2024, 2025 or 2026; no upper age limit specified by NTA
data_source: Official NTA portal; cross-checked via Careers360 and CollegeSearch
notes: Conducted in two sessions per year (January and April).

conducting_body: Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) -- organizing IIT rotates annually on a zonal basis; IIT Roorkee is the organizing institute for the 2026 cycle
purpose: Admission to undergraduate/integrated programs at the IITs
eligibility_summary: Must rank among the top ~2,50,000 qualifiers in JEE Main; passed Class 12 with Physics/Chemistry/Mathematics for the first time in 2025 or 2026; born on or after 1 Oct 2001 (5-yr relaxation for SC/ST/PwD)
data_source: Official JEE Advanced portal (jeeadv.ac.in) and Information Brochure PDF
notes: Organizing IIT changes every year; verify current-year host institute each cycle.

conducting_body: National Testing Agency (NTA)
purpose: Single national entrance test for admission to undergraduate medical courses (MBBS/BDS/AYUSH/veterinary and other allied programs) in India
eligibility_summary: Must have completed/completing Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Biotechnology and English, with minimum 50% aggregate in PCB (40% SC/ST/OBC, 45% PwD); minimum age 17 by year of admission
data_source: Official NTA NEET portal

conducting_body: National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS)
purpose: Admission to MD, MS, PG Diploma, Post-MBBS DNB, Direct 6-Year DrNB and NBEMS Diploma courses
eligibility_summary: MBBS degree with completed compulsory internship; open to Indian citizens, NRIs, OCIs, PIOs and eligible foreign nationals
data_source: Official NBEMS/NBE portals (natboard.edu.in / nbe.edu.in) cross-checked via Testbook and Careers360 news coverage
notes: NEET PG 2026 registration opened 1 July 2026; exam scheduled 30 Aug 2026 per NBEMS notification.

conducting_body: National Testing Agency (NTA)
purpose: Common entrance test for admission to undergraduate programs at central universities and 200+ participating state/deemed/private universities across India
eligibility_summary: Passed or appearing in Class 12 (10+2) or equivalent examination; specific subject/marks criteria set by each participating university
data_source: Official NTA CUET(UG) portal

conducting_body: National Testing Agency (NTA)
purpose: Common entrance test for admission to postgraduate programs at participating central, state and deemed universities
eligibility_summary: Bachelor's degree with at least 50% marks (45% for reserved categories); final-year candidates also eligible
data_source: Official NTA CUET(PG) exam portal
notes: CUET PG 2026 covered 157 subjects across ~40 participating universities (35 central, 6 state, 1 deemed) per NTA-linked reporting.

conducting_body: Consortium of National Law Universities
purpose: National entrance test for admission to the 5-year integrated LLB (undergraduate) programme and the LLM (postgraduate) programme at 24+ National Law Universities
eligibility_summary: UG: passed/appearing Class 12 with minimum 45% marks (40% SC/ST); no upper age limit. PG (LLM): LLB degree (3-year or 5-year) with minimum 50% marks (45% SC/ST)
data_source: Official Consortium of NLUs website cross-checked via Careers360 Law and Shiksha
notes: Single CLAT exam covers both UG and PG (LLM) admission cycles administered by the same Consortium.

conducting_body: Indian Institute of Management (IIM) -- host IIM rotates annually; IIM Indore is the conducting IIM for the 2026 cycle
purpose: Admission to MBA/PGDM programmes at the 22 IIMs and 1,000+ other business schools in India
eligibility_summary: Bachelor's degree with minimum 50% marks (45% SC/ST/PwD); final-year students eligible; no age limit
data_source: Official CAT portal (iimcat.ac.in) cross-checked via MBAUniverse and Careers360
notes: Conducting IIM changes annually; verify host institute each cycle.

conducting_body: National Coordination Board -- GATE, jointly administered by IISc Bangalore and 7 IITs; organizing institute rotates annually (IIT Guwahati conducted GATE 2026; IIT Madras is the designated organizing institute for GATE 2027, pending official notification)
purpose: Admission to M.Tech/M.E./direct Ph.D. programmes at IITs/NITs/IIITs/IISc and other institutes; scores also used by many Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs) for recruitment
eligibility_summary: Currently in or completed final year of a recognized Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Technology/Architecture or equivalent (B.E./B.Tech/B.Arch etc.); no upper age limit
data_source: Cross-checked via multiple education portals (Shiksha, CollegeDekho, Careers360); official 2027 notification not yet published as of collection date
notes: GATE 2027 organizing institute (IIT Madras) is reported consistently across sources but had not been confirmed via an official GATE notification/brochure at time of collection; re-verify once the official brochure is released (expected Jul/Aug 2026).

conducting_body: National Testing Agency (NTA) on behalf of the University Grants Commission (UGC)
purpose: Determines eligibility of Indian nationals for award of Junior Research Fellowship (JRF), appointment as Assistant Professor, and/or admission to Ph.D. programmes in Indian universities and colleges
eligibility_summary: Master's degree with minimum 55% marks (50% for reserved categories) from a UGC-recognized university, or final-year Master's students
data_source: Official NTA UGC-NET portal
notes: Conducted in Computer Based Test mode; historically run in two cycles per year (e.g., June and December sessions).

conducting_body: Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) on behalf of the Ministry of Education
purpose: Eligibility test (not a direct recruitment exam) for teaching positions in Classes I-VIII in KVS, NVS, Army Public Schools, state government schools, DSSSB schools and CBSE-affiliated private schools
eligibility_summary: Paper I (Classes I-V): Senior Secondary/12th with minimum 50% plus a 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education (or equivalent). Paper II (Classes VI-VIII): Graduation plus B.Ed, or 12th plus 4-year B.El.Ed/equivalent. Minimum age 17.
data_source: Official CBSE CTET portal
notes: exam_level is a judgment call: CTET is a teacher-eligibility certification rather than a degree-admission exam, and its two papers straddle Undergraduate/Postgraduate entry qualifications (12th+diploma for Paper I; graduate+B.Ed for Paper II). Certificate validity is now lifetime per current CBSE/NCTE guidelines.

conducting_body: XLRI Jamshedpur, on behalf of the Xavier Association of Management Institutes (XAMI)
purpose: Admission to MBA/PGDM programmes at XLRI and 160+ other business schools that accept XAT scores
eligibility_summary: Bachelor's degree from a recognized university (no NTA/XLRI-mandated minimum percentage found); final-year students eligible; no age limit; XLRI's PGDM (GM) additionally requires 5 years' work experience
data_source: Official XAT portal (xatonline.in) cross-checked via InsideIIM and Shiksha

conducting_body: National Testing Agency (NTA) on behalf of the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR)
purpose: All India Entrance Examination for Admission to Master's degree programmes in agriculture and allied sciences, and award of ICAR PG scholarships
eligibility_summary: Bachelor's degree in the relevant agriculture/allied discipline; specific percentage and subject criteria set by ICAR each cycle
data_source: Official NTA ICAR exam portal
notes: The former ICAR AIEEA UG exam was discontinued after 2022; UG admissions now flow through CUET (ICAR-UG), a separate NTA-conducted test, so it was excluded from this dataset to avoid listing a discontinued exam as active.

conducting_body: National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS), in coordination with the Pharmacy Council of India (PCI)
purpose: Admission to Master of Pharmacy (M.Pharm) programmes
eligibility_summary: 4-year Bachelor's degree in Pharmacy (B.Pharm); final-year B.Pharm students also eligible; no upper age limit
data_source: Official NBEMS portal (natboard.edu.in) cross-checked via Careers360 news
notes: GPAT was transferred from the National Testing Agency (NTA) to NBEMS starting with the 2024 cycle; older references to gpat.nta.nic.in are outdated -- current official portal is natboard.edu.in.

conducting_body: Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University Hyderabad (JNTUH), on behalf of the Telangana State Council of Higher Education (TGCHE)
purpose: Admission to Engineering, Agriculture and Pharmacy undergraduate degree programmes in Telangana
eligibility_summary: Passed 10+2 or equivalent with Mathematics/Physics/Chemistry (Engineering) or Biology/Physics/Chemistry (Agriculture/Pharmacy); Indian nationality; age requirements apply
data_source: Official TGCHE EAPCET portal cross-checked via Testbook and Careers360
notes: Renamed from TS EAMCET to TG EAPCET in 2023 after medical (MBBS/BDS) seats were fully moved to NEET-based admission; conducted in English, Telugu and Urdu.

conducting_body: Mahatma Gandhi University, Nalgonda, on behalf of the Telangana State Council of Higher Education (TGCHE)
purpose: Admission to MBA and MCA programmes at universities in Telangana and their affiliated colleges
eligibility_summary: Bachelor's degree in any discipline (except Oriental Languages) with minimum 50% marks (45% reserved categories) for MBA; Mathematics at 10+2 or graduation level for MCA; minimum age 19, no upper limit
data_source: Official TGCHE ICET portal cross-checked via Shiksha and MBAUniverse

conducting_body: Kakatiya University, Warangal, on behalf of the Telangana State Council of Higher Education (TGCHE)
purpose: Admission to the 2-year Bachelor of Education (B.Ed) programme in Telangana
eligibility_summary: Bachelor's degree with minimum 50% marks (40% SC/ST/PH); minimum age 19 as of 1 July of the admission year; no upper age limit; unlimited attempts
data_source: Official TGCHE EdCET portal cross-checked via Careers360 news
notes: exam_level recorded as Undergraduate because B.Ed is formally a Bachelor's-level degree under Indian nomenclature, even though it requires a prior bachelor's degree for admission.

conducting_body: Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University Hyderabad (JNTUH), on behalf of the Telangana State Council of Higher Education (TGCHE)
purpose: Admission to M.Tech/M.E. and M.Pharm postgraduate engineering programmes in Telangana
eligibility_summary: Bachelor's degree in the relevant engineering/pharmacy field with minimum 50% marks (45% SC/ST); final-year candidates eligible; GATE/GPAT-qualified candidates are exempt from appearing
data_source: Official TGCHE PGECET portal cross-checked via Careerpower and Sarvgyan

conducting_body: Osmania University, Hyderabad, on behalf of the Telangana State Council of Higher Education (TGCHE)
purpose: Admission to 3-year and 5-year integrated LLB programmes in Telangana
eligibility_summary: 3-year LLB: bachelor's degree in any stream, minimum 45% marks. 5-year LLB: passed Class 12 with minimum 45% marks. Indian nationals/Telangana residents; no upper age limit
data_source: Cross-checked via Toprankers, Shiksha and Careers360 Law (application portal lawcet.tgche.ac.in)

conducting_body: Osmania University, Hyderabad, on behalf of the Telangana State Council of Higher Education (TGCHE)
purpose: Admission to the 2-year LLM (Master of Laws) programme at law colleges and universities in Telangana
eligibility_summary: LLB degree (3-year or 5-year) with minimum 50% marks (45% reserved categories); final-year LLB students eligible; no age limit
data_source: Cross-checked via Shiksha and Findmycollege (application portal lawcet.tgche.ac.in)

conducting_body: State Board of Technical Education and Training (SBTET) Telangana
purpose: Admission to Diploma courses in Engineering/Technology, Non-Engineering, Agriculture, Horticulture and Animal Husbandry/Fisheries at polytechnics in Telangana
eligibility_summary: Passed SSC (Class 10) or equivalent with minimum 35% marks; Indian nationals, domicile of Telangana/Andhra Pradesh; no age limit
data_source: Official SBTET Telangana POLYCET portal cross-checked via Sakshi Education and Collegedunia

conducting_body: JNTU Kakinada, on behalf of the Andhra Pradesh State Council of Higher Education (APSCHE)
purpose: Admission to Engineering, Agriculture and Pharmacy undergraduate degree programmes in Andhra Pradesh
eligibility_summary: Indian citizen/PIO/OCI; resident of Andhra Pradesh or Telangana per local/non-local rules; passed/appearing Class 12 with Physics/Chemistry/Mathematics (Engineering, min age 17) or Biology/Physics/Chemistry (Agriculture/Pharmacy, min age 16)
data_source: Official APSCHE CETS EAPCET portal cross-checked via Testbook and Collegedunia
notes: Renamed from AP EAMCET to AP EAPCET after MBBS/BDS admissions moved fully to NEET-based selection.

conducting_body: Andhra University, Visakhapatnam, on behalf of the Andhra Pradesh State Council of Higher Education (APSCHE)
purpose: Admission to MBA and MCA programmes in Andhra Pradesh
eligibility_summary: MBA: 3-year bachelor's degree with minimum 50% marks (45% SC/ST/BC). MCA: Mathematics at 10+2 or graduation level with minimum 50% marks (45% reserved categories); final-year students eligible; no upper age limit
data_source: Cross-checked via PW Live, Apollo University blog and AP Teachers portal (application portal cets.apsche.ap.gov.in/ICET)

conducting_body: Acharya Nagarjuna University, Guntur, on behalf of the Andhra Pradesh State Council of Higher Education (APSCHE)
purpose: Admission to the 2-year Bachelor of Education (B.Ed) programme in Andhra Pradesh
eligibility_summary: Bachelor's degree in any discipline; minimum 50% aggregate (General), 45% (BC), 40% (SC/ST/Differently Abled); minimum age 19 as of 1 July of the admission year; no upper age limit
data_source: Cross-checked via Manabadi and Shiksha; convenor contact confirms Acharya Nagarjuna University as conducting institution
notes: Some secondary sources named Dravidian University, Kuppam as the conducting institution; the 2026 official notification/convenor contact details point to Acharya Nagarjuna University, which is treated here as authoritative. exam_level recorded as Undergraduate for the same reason as TG EdCET (B.Ed is a Bachelor's-level award).

conducting_body: Andhra University, Visakhapatnam, on behalf of the Andhra Pradesh State Council of Higher Education (APSCHE)
purpose: Admission to M.E./M.Tech and M.Pharm postgraduate engineering programmes in Andhra Pradesh
eligibility_summary: Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech or equivalent) in the relevant field with minimum 50% marks (45% SC/ST); resident of Andhra Pradesh or Telangana
data_source: Cross-checked via Careers360, Shiksha and Collegedekho (application portal cets.apsche.ap.gov.in)

conducting_body: Sri Padmavati Mahila Visvavidyalayam (SPMVV), Tirupati, on behalf of the Andhra Pradesh State Council of Higher Education (APSCHE)
purpose: Admission to 3-year and 5-year integrated LLB programmes in Andhra Pradesh
eligibility_summary: 3-year LLB: bachelor's degree with minimum 45% aggregate. 5-year LLB: passed Class 12 in any stream from a recognized board. Indian nationals meeting AP domicile eligibility; no age limit
data_source: Official APSCHE CETS LAWCET portal cross-checked via Shiksha and Collegedunia

conducting_body: Sri Padmavati Mahila Visvavidyalayam (SPMVV), Tirupati, on behalf of the Andhra Pradesh State Council of Higher Education (APSCHE)
purpose: Admission to the LLM (Master of Laws) programme at universities and affiliated law colleges in Andhra Pradesh
eligibility_summary: 3-year or 5-year LLB degree; must complete graduation by the time of counselling; Indian citizens or valid OCI/PIO status
data_source: Cross-checked via Shiksha, Careers360 Law and Indcareer (application portal cets.apsche.ap.gov.in/LAWCET)

conducting_body: State Board of Technical Education and Training (SBTET) Andhra Pradesh, Vijayawada
purpose: Admission to technical and non-technical Diploma courses at Polytechnic institutes in Andhra Pradesh
eligibility_summary: Passed Class 10 (SSC) from the AP or Telangana state board or equivalent, with minimum 35% aggregate marks; Indian nationals resident in Andhra Pradesh
data_source: Cross-checked via Careers360, Collegedekho and Manabadi; conducting body confirmed via apsbtet.ap.gov.in
